changelog: ⚡ Direct Peer-to-Peer WebRTC Sync: 6-digit PIN pairing establishes direct WebRTC DataChannel connectivity over Google STUN, delivering instant sub-20ms syncing with zero server load and zero quotas
🛡️ Encrypted Multi-Relay Failover: Introduced multi-relay architecture with automatic failover across ntfy.envs.net (primary) and ntfy.sh (secondary backup)
🔇 Zero-Spam Keepalive Engine: Completely eliminated rapid 10s PING/PONG and 15s reconnect spam, ensuring pairing and sync never hit rate limits
🌐 Universal Cross-Network Syncing: Full sync functionality across different networks, 4G/5G mobile cellular data, and home Wi-Fi with zero configuration
🎯 Deterministic Handshake & State Preservation: Fixed peer state transitions and race condition during initial pairing handshake
